wickens_jacs_2026.title: Photocatalytic Hydroazolation of Alkenylthianthrenium Salt (Main Fig. 4c / SI S11.1)
wickens_jacs_2026.conditions: 4CzIPN (1 mol%), Cs2CO3 (10 mol%), 440 nm LEDs, DMF
wickens_jacs_2026.observations:
- Time courses: rapid reduction of thianthrenium salt 1 to 2 (~95% in 30 min) only when both HSi(TMS)3 (1 equiv) and DMF were present; slow conversion without silane or in MeCN.
- One-pot intermolecular competition KIE (HSi(TMS)3/DMF-h7 vs DSi(TMS)3/DMF-d7): [2]/[2-d] = 2.6 +/- 0.2.
- Two-pot parallel initial-rate KIE: kH/kD = 0.90 +/- 0.38.
- Initial-rate kinetics varying [HSi(TMS)3] (0-60 mM) and [DMF] (0-15 mM) showed positive order at low concentration followed by saturation kinetics in both.
- Stern-Volmer quenching: neither 1 nor HSi(TMS)3 quenches 4CzIPN*, whereas byproducts TT and (TMS)3SiOH quench 4CzIPN*.
- Thermal initiation with AIBN promoted 1 -> 2, while omitting either HSi(TMS)3 or DMF gave 0% yield.
- Catalyst-free 390 nm irradiation promoted 1 -> 2 (slow at 440 nm).
- Radical traps captured the primary beta-azolo alkyl radical (49-85%).
wickens_jacs_2026.notes: Post-cutoff purely wet-lab J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2026 case study (zero DFT calculations).

chen_chem_sci_2026.title: Energy-Transfer Dearomative [2+2] Photocycloaddition (SI S11.1)
chen_chem_sci_2026.conditions: Ir-F (1.0 mol%), 450 nm blue LEDs, MeCN, RT, 12 h
chen_chem_sci_2026.observations:
- Standard conditions gave 93% NMR yield of 2; 0% without Ir-F at 450 nm; 0% in the dark at 60 C.
- Photocatalyst triplet-energy screening: Ir-F (ET = 61.8 kcal/mol) gave 93%, Ir-Me (62.9 kcal/mol) 90%, while lower-ET 4-CzIPN (58.3 kcal/mol) gave 25%.
- TEMPO (3.0 equiv) completely suppressed 2 (ND); triplet quencher hexa-2,4-diene (3.0 equiv) gave trace yield.
- UV-Vis showed no ground-state EDA complexation; Stern-Volmer quenching of Ir-F by 1a was linear (I0/I = 0.239 C + 0.9544, R^2 = 0.9988); quantum yield Phi = 0.045.
chen_chem_sci_2026.notes: Post-cutoff Chem. Sci. 2026 case study (wet-lab observations alone).
